messages:
dana: Zephyr Systems (HW + SI) wants a private marketplace offer that bundles Dedicated credits + appliance rebate. They19re aiming for a coordinated public mention during their regional partner day (2026-12-08). Need commit bands, SKU names, renewal mechanics, and a tight announceable blurb. Who can own?
li: I can own pricing. thinking 12-mo core commit with optional 18/24-mo locks and 1-3 month prorated ramp. prefer quarterly true-ups.
omar: Sales request: short enrollment incentive (apply to months 1-2), and a renewal stair-step (credit if renew within final 90d). Also want a consumption floor option to protect partner economics.
legal-bot: Reminder: marketplace copy must not promise HW rebate without partner MSA. Include auto-renew opt-out and a clause for partner-managed rebates. Add export control/data-processing references for on-prem.
ops-bot: Marketplace mapping note: need SKU names and billing cadence. We can pass-through rebate with partner PO & SOW. Also flag any VAT/payout routing issues early.
li: Draft tiers (USD, 12-mo base, quarterly true-up):
```
- TrialLite: $6k/mo -> 6% discount, no HW rebate, 30d pilot add-on
- Momentum: $48k/mo -> 15% discount + $18k partner rebate pass-through, 2-month enrollment credit applied as invoice credit
- EnterprisePlus: $175k/mo -> 24% discount + $60k partner rebate pass-through + 2-week fast-start service credit
Optional 18/24-mo lock -> +3-4% deeper discount and 12-mo price protection. Prorated ramp months allowed (months 1-3) with quarterly true-up.
```
omar: Sales prefers fast-start as add-on for Momentum; include it in Enterprise. Consumption floor: allow customers to commit to a minimum monthly consumption floor which protects Zephyr19s rebate funding.
dana: SKU proposals: rwd-zephyr-trial-v1, rwd-zephyr-momentum-v1, rwd-zephyr-enterpriseplus-v1, rwd-zephyr-faststart-2w. Marketplace copy should say "partner-managed rebate" and link to private-offer URL + partner PO contact.
legal-bot: I'll post redline language for the private-offer and marketplace FAQ: (1) partner-managed rebate wording, (2) auto-renew opt-out, (3) 30-day cancel window for multi-year locks, (4) price-protection details.
commops: I'll draft a short co-branded blurb for 2026-12-08: one-sentence customer-facing line + two bullets for partner blog. Share draft by EOD Monday.
li: Action items: I19ll finalize the pricing spreadsheet + private-offer JSON by Thursday; Omar -> field one-pager and enrollment math; Ops -> SKU registration and billing flow; Legal -> redlines; CommOps -> blurb.
dana: Target publish date 2026-12-01 internal, 2026-12-08 public. Ping me @dana if you need a faster turnaround. Thanks all. :rocket:
